content.title: Who Is Alex in 'Paradise'? All About the Cryptic Clues Behind Season 2’s Biggest Mystery
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Paradise season 2 has hinted at clues and theories about who or what Alex isAlex was first mentioned in the premiere, "Graceland"The Paradise season 2 finale, "Exodus," debuts March 30 on Hulu Warning: Spoilers ahead for Paradise season 2! Since they were first mentioned in the season 2 premiere, Paradise viewers have been wondering: Who is Alex? The cryptic teases of who or what Alex is have been peppered throughout the season's first seven episodes, with more clues dropping, but there has been no definitive answer given — yet. The penultimate episode, "The Final Countdown," concluded with Sam "Sinatra" Redmond (Julianne Nicholson) coming face-to-face with whoever or whatever Alex is, though credits began rolling before an identity was revealed. So, ahead of the March 30 finale, here's what we know so far about the mysterious entity. Link is on his way to the bunker to "kill Alex" Thomas Doherty in 'Paradise'. Disney/Ser Baffo Alex is first mentioned in the season 2 premiere, "Graceland." As Link (Thomas Doherty) and his group of survivors are preparing to leave the Graceland property, he tries to convince Annie (Shailene Woodley) to come along with them. While Link pleads with Annie, Link's right-hand man, Geiger (Michael McGrady), tells him it's time to go. "You're the one who's been going on and on about this bunker and the fate of the world. This is not the time to be catching feelings," Geiger tells Link. "Now listen, we've gotta get to the bunker, we gotta get inside and we've got to kill Alex, right?" Shortly after, Link gets a nosebleed, a mysterious occurrence that plagues other characters, like Xavier (Sterling K. Brown), throughout the season. Alex is the name of Henry Miller's deceased wife Jon Beavers, Thomas Doherty in 'Paradise'. Disney/Ser Baffo A pre-bunker flashback during season 2, episode 3, "Another Day in Paradise," introduces Henry Miller (Patrick Fischler), a scientist and professor, who owns Vestige Quantum, a tech company Sam is trying to buy. Notably, Henry also teaches the grad course Advanced Wave Functions, Superposition and Quantum Entanglement. On orders from Sam, assassin Billy Pace (Jon Beavers) goes to Henry's house to kill him. When he arrives, he finds Henry taking care of his bedridden wife, Alex (Gwen Holloway), who has Huntington's disease. Henry kills Alex by lethal injection, before Billy shoots Henry dead. Afterward, Billy gets a nosebleed and walks out into the living room, where he comes across Link, who is revealed to be Henry's protégé. Billy agrees to Henry's request and spares Link's life. Sam refers to Alex as "her" Julianne Nicholson in 'Paradise'. Disney/Ser Baffo It is still unclear who or what Alex is, but Sam refers to Alex as "her." In season 2, episode 3, Sam sits down with her housekeeper Carmen (Maria-Elena Laas), and asks her, "How is Alex?" "Alex is well. The power problem has been resolved?" Carmen responds, referring to Sam siphoning energy from the bunker to power her project. "Oh yes, I made sure of that. Any other messages? Do they have an estimate?" Sam asks. "No messages. It's too unpredictable. But she is getting closer," Carmen answers, as Sam tells her, "I'll have to live with 'closer.' " In season 2, episode 7, Link admits to Sam why he made his way to the bunker. "I'm here for Alex," he reveals. Sam abruptly ends their meeting, and as she walks him back to the bunker's exit, Link says, "I will find Alex, and we will end this." "Well, I will do everything in my power to protect her, and I won't let you or anyone else destroy what I have built," she threatens. Someone named Alex Q. sent a warning about Jane 'Paradise' season 2, episode 6. Disney/Ser Baffo Season 2, episode 6, "Jane," tells the origin story of secret service agent Jane Driscoll (Nicole Brydon Bloom), who is enacting a mysterious master plan down in the bunker. In a flashback to the time of Jane's birth, a Circuit City employee receives an email from someone named Alex Q., who writes, "A killer will be born on June 6 at 12:01 a.m." Later, the employee sits outside of a hospital waiting for the newborn. He then spots Jane and her mother, who is being wheeled out after recently giving birth. He asks the new mom about the baby's birth date and time, and once he realizes Jane is who the message was about, he says, "Listen to me. She's a killer. Not now, but she will be, but she can be stopped, when it matters." "I have a message for that baby," the employee yells. Unfortunately, he is pulled away by security before delivering the warning. Related Stories Gabriela has been searching for mentions of "Alex" in her therapy transcripts Sarah Shahi in 'Paradise'. Disney/Ser Baffo Dr. Gabriela Torabi (Sarah Shahi), a therapist and Sam's friend, is also on the case, trying to find out who Alex is. She searches her therapy session transcripts and the list of Paradise citizens named Alex — but she only arrives at dead ends. While Gabriela has yet to find an answer, her curiosity nearly gets her killed. In season 2, episode 7, Jane tries to murder Gabriela, but Gabriela stabs her in the back before Jane is able to shoot her. Alex is kept in a secret separate part of the bunker Sarah Shahi in 'Paradise'. Disney/Anne Marie Fox Following her meeting with Link in season 2, episode 7, Sam travels by tram to a separate part of the underground bunker. After Sam arrives at the secret area, she puts on a blue jacket and opens a secure room, which glows with a warm light as she enters. "Hi, Alex," she says with a smile — but the episode ends before Alex's identity is unveiled.
